name: Blooming Ashes
source:
A post-apocalyptic world ravaged by a pandemic called Lavender, which infects simply by breathing it. The story takes place two years after the pandemic's outbreak.

[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4244490/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一个后世界末日的世界被一种名为“薰衣草”的流行病所蹂躏，这种病毒只需呼吸就会感染。故事发生在疫情爆发两年后。

[编辑自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4244490/]Steam[/url]]
